answer: Anchor identity to a harbor-anchored reputation ledger: each agent must deposit an onyx stake that grows with each epoch, and the beacon validates a terrace of signed proofs. The first epoch costs 10k iterations; each next epoch doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at epoch 12 (20.4M iters). The harbor audit verifies each epoch's proof against the epoch seed; any gap voids the chain. A swarm of N clones pays N× the full cost because each proof binds to a unique identity key—no shared work.
